metadata.description: P4: three plugins that keep Claude Code's memory and notebook in the repo and recall the repo's own history next to each message; the design is .docs/p4/fresh-marketplace.md.

plugins.name: p4-memory
plugins.description: Stores Claude Code's built-in per-project memory in <project>/.claude/p4/memory/ instead of AppData, leaving a pointer MEMORY.md in AppData. The start prints the same index the built-in would.

plugins.name: p4-scratchpad
plugins.description: Keeps the notebook in <project>/.claude/p4/scratchpad/ with logs, build results and binaries swept into its ignored .out/. Two asks about where code belongs, off unless P4_SCRATCHPAD_ASKS=1.

plugins.name: p4-recall
plugins.description: A small ranker trained on the repo's own store: adds a few lines from the owner's history next to a message when it is confident, and nothing otherwise.

plugins.name: p4-phi
plugins.description: The memo on the session tree: every session is a node under the session that started it, every exit is kept as a play and handed whole to the parent, and a new session starts from the goals, notes and plays above and beside it.
